description: Returns the statutory dates for a regime with the Article behind each one, and for UAE Corporate Tax computes the actual due date from the financial year end. Use it when someone asks: when is my UAE corporate tax return due, what is the deadline for a financial year ending 31 March or 31 December, when do I have to pay the corporate tax, how many days have I got left, is the deadline 30 September 2026, what is the penalty for filing late, when is the first CBAM declaration due, when does the CBAM definitive period start, when do CBAM certificates go on sale, is there still a quarterly CBAM report. Use this rather than recalling a date: UAE Corporate Tax has no fixed annual deadline, it is nine months after each company's own Tax Period end, and the CBAM dates were rewritten by Regulation (EU) 2025/2083.

financial_year_end.description: For uae_ct, the Tax Period end as YYYY-MM-DD. The due date is computed from it.
